messages:
maria: Quick thread  finalizing rollout choreography for tenant-routing v2. Need explicit dual-guard logic + ops override before shiproom.
omar: timeline preference: EU beta this week, then NA next week. Customers asked for EU-priority.
claire: Dual-guard = (error_rate >= 1.4x for 5m) AND (p95 >= +25% for 10m) => auto-rollback. Single extreme spike (error_rate >= 4x) => immediate rollback.
kevin: Implementation detail: soft-fail to legacy stack, inc metric routing.fallback_count, and tag traces with routing.canary=true. Also include a per-tenant opt-out: feature:tenant-routing/v2.opt_out
ben: Ops override: a 2-step manual path: 1) product confirms in #prod-ops, 2) oncall runs `redwood flags unset feature:tenant-routing/v2` (CLI)  documented runbook will list escalation and cooldown.
maria: Canary windows: EU slice 6% for 20m, NA slice 12% for 20m. If stable, increase by 20% every 2h until 100% or manual stop.
claire: Monitoring checks we need added to dashboards: routing.error_rate (per-region), routing.p95_latency, routing.fallback_count, routing.success_rate_by_tenant.
kevin: Add a low-noise warn alert at 1.2x baseline for 10m to catch regressions early. Critical at 1.5x for 5m to trigger auto actions.
ben: I'll draft the ops override doc and include exact CLI snippets + Slack escalation text.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-1754321987-eu (starts in 15m). Notifying oncall and product.
maria: Thanks all  I'll assemble the shiproom slides and attach checklist: [ ] runbook reviewed, [ ] dashboards up, [ ] legal signoff for EU. See you at shiproom.
